verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's own multi-region docs describe a table-locality setting that controls how a table's data is accessed, framed as making global applications easier to run. Community comments confirm worldwide clusters and mention a Follower-Reads feature, though one says it was released as an enterprise feature. The evidence never explicitly says data or replicas can be pinned near users or that reads become low-latency, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of placing data or replicas in specific regions near users, documented low-latency local or follower reads with no licensing ambiguity, and independent hands-on corroboration of worldwide read latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide

citations.quote: CockroachDB multi-region capabilities make it easier to run global applications.
_Table locality_ determines how CockroachDB optimizes access to a table's data.
So global transaction with cluster world wide.
